entities.name: Little Red Riding Hood
entities.height: A small child, about three-fifths the height of a grown person.
entities.spec: A small, slender girl with warm light skin, a round face, rosy cheeks, and brown eyes. Her chestnut-brown hair forms two short braids reaching her shoulders, each tied with a cream ribbon. She wears a scarlet, knee-length hooded cloak tied beneath her chin, with a roomy hood covering the crown of her head. Beneath it are a long-sleeved warm-cream dress, a moss-green apron, cream stockings, and plain brown leather shoes.

entities.name: Little Red Riding Hood’s mother
entities.spec: A grown woman of average build with warm light skin, a softly rounded face, and brown eyes. Her chestnut-brown hair is parted in the middle and gathered into a low bun. She wears an ankle-length sage-green dress with long sleeves, a warm-cream apron tied at the waist, and plain brown leather shoes.

entities.name: bread
entities.height: A small loaf about 22 cm long, comfortably held in two adult hands.
entities.spec: A single oval loaf with a domed top, a flat underside, and a golden-brown crust. Three diagonal scoring marks cross the top, exposing paler cream-colored ridges of baked dough.

entities.name: small cake
entities.height: A small cake about 12 cm across and 5 cm high, fitting on one outstretched adult hand.
entities.spec: A low, round cake with golden sides and a flat top covered by a smooth layer of warm-cream icing. The icing stops at the upper edge rather than covering the sides, and the cake has no decorations or cut portions.

entities.name: wicker basket
entities.height: A child-sized carrying basket, about 35 cm long and 25 cm wide, carried in one hand by its handle.
entities.spec: An oval basket woven from honey-brown willow wicker, with a flat base, gently flared sides, and a thick braided rim. A single rigid arched handle rises above the open top; there is no lid or fabric lining. At the start it contains one golden-brown oval loaf with three diagonal scores and one small round cake with cream icing, both visible inside.

entities.name: Grandmother
entities.height: An elderly woman slightly shorter than an average grown person, with a mild stoop.
entities.spec: A slender elderly woman with warm light skin, a narrow, gently wrinkled face, brown eyes, and small round spectacles with thin dark-brown frames. Her silver-white hair is drawn into a small low bun. She wears a loose, ankle-length warm-cream nightdress with long sleeves and a high gathered neckline, a sage-green knitted shawl, and soft brown slippers.

entities.name: wolf
entities.height: A large natural wolf, reaching a grown person's waist at the shoulder when on all fours.
entities.spec: A natural, unclothed wolf with a lean, long-legged body, a deep chest, large paws, and a long bushy tail; he normally moves on all fours rather than standing like a person. His fur is warm gray, with charcoal along his back and tail tip and pale cream on his muzzle, throat, and underside. He has a long tapered muzzle, a broad black nose, tall triangular ears, amber eyes, and prominent pointed white teeth.

entities.name: daisies
entities.height: Small plants about 15–25 cm tall, reaching an adult's ankle or lower shin.
entities.spec: Small natural daisies growing in loose clumps, with slender green stems and narrow green leaves near their bases. Each flower has one round golden-yellow center surrounded by a single ring of slim white petals.

entities.name: Grandmother’s nightcap
entities.height: An adult-sized soft cap, small enough to cup in two hands.
entities.spec: A white cotton nightcap with a softly rounded, roomy crown and a gathered opening edged by a narrow ruffle. Two narrow white ties extend from the lower edges, and the fabric has no pattern or colored trim.

entities.name: Grandmother’s quilt
entities.height: A single-bed-sized quilt, about 140 cm wide and 190 cm long.
entities.spec: A thick rectangular patchwork quilt made from equal-sized squares alternating warm cream, sage green, and muted moss green in a repeating sequence. Small diamond-shaped stitches cross each square, and a solid moss-green binding runs around all four edges.

entities.name: woodcutter
entities.height: A tall grown man, about a head taller than Mother.
entities.spec: A broad-shouldered, sturdy man with lightly tanned skin, brown eyes, short dark-brown hair, and a neatly trimmed brown beard. He wears a moss-green shirt with sleeves rolled to his elbows, dark-brown trousers, heavy brown leather boots, and a wide brown leather belt. A large pair of shears is secured in a leather loop on his belt, with its two black iron handles clearly exposed.

entities.name: pair of shears
entities.height: About 25 cm long, held and operated with one adult hand.
entities.spec: A sturdy pair of shears with two straight, pointed silver-gray steel blades joined by a single round brass pivot. The handles are black iron loops, with one loop slightly larger than the other.

entities.name: stones
entities.height: Eight stones, each about 6–10 cm across and small enough to hold in one adult hand.
entities.spec: Eight solid, irregularly oval stones with rounded edges and slightly uneven surfaces. They vary between medium gray and warm gray, with a few small tan flecks and no sharp points or markings.

entities.name: needle
entities.height: About 5 cm long, easily held between two fingertips.
entities.spec: A straight, slender silver-colored steel sewing needle with a sharp point at one end. Its opposite end has a narrow oval eye, with no decorative details or attached handle.

entities.name: thread
entities.height: A small spool about 4 cm high, fitting comfortably in one adult hand.
entities.spec: Fine warm-ivory sewing thread wound neatly around a small natural-tan wooden spool. The spool has a narrow cylindrical center and two flat round ends, with a short loose end of thread resting against the winding.
